reviews.text: We love Georgina! We started signing up for hikes with Furry tails  when our puppy was 6 months old and have been with her pack ever since.

A person at the off leash dog area near our new home told me about her dog's Furry Tails adventures. I contacted Georgina at Furry Tails - we had a chat, and then arranged for her to come over to meet my moyen poodle. The process was easy, and we were both confident that my dog has the basic obedience and social skills to go on off-leash doggie adventures with her pack. Georgina had clearly introduced dogs to the pack before, and knew how to make it easy and successful. My dog has gone on about 10 adventures, and it's so cool!! She has always been a "good girl", and now she is an extra, extra-good and sweet girl! She plays so beautifully with other dogs, she listens the first time! She even stopped at a cement walkway running through the in the middle of a grassy park to look back and check with me before crossing to get her ball! Because of her times with Georgina and the pack, my dog is happier, healthier, and literally smarter! Amazing! I couldn't be happier with this service. The online portal is awesome and I get little daily report cards, pictures and videos. Furry Tails is a trustworthy, responsible, safe operation where dogs and their families are so well taken care of. I highly recommend, and I am so grateful for running into the lady at the park who introduced me to Furry Tails :)
Love me some Furry Tails.  Georgina and her staff are reliable, responsive and really care about my fur babies ❤️

Georgina home sat my 5-year-old Shih tzu, Theo, for 8 hours yesterday, and I couldn’t be happier.

My dog has never been left alone before and gets anxious around new people, but he was completely comfortable with Georgina from the meet and greet session. She was also so efficient and responsive with correspondence throughout, which made the whole process easy and stress-free.

When I got home, Theo was calm, happy, and clearly well looked after. Georgina was professional, caring, and sent me updates so I could relax knowing my baby was in good hands. You can tell she genuinely loves animals.

I’d trust Georgina with my dog again in a heartbeat and highly recommend Furry Tails Toronto to anyone looking for a reliable, kind pet sitter in Toronto.
The team has been so helpful and caring!
I am so delighted that I had Giorgina take care of my little Peppi. I knew that Peppi was in good loving care.

My family recently adopted a 1.5 year old rescue. I reached out to Georgina to inquire about regular walks with her company and she was very responsive and helpful. We really appreciate the support your company offers!  In particular, the walkers have made a real  effort to understand our new rescue pup and help him to engage in positive behaviours during leashed walks. The walkers have been creative and understanding and their work with him is helping to reduce his reactivity significantly.  This company has an online booking system where you can see a 'report card' that shares the experience of that day's walk. It is really helpful and easy to use.  Great service with staff who really care!

We’ve been using Furry Tails for a few months for our dog, Mishka, and they have been absolutely wonderful. Georgina is very responsive to communication and our dog is in love with Christa. She is punctual, friendly, and treats Mishka like her own dog. We’ve also had a few walks with Jemima and she has been absolutely lovely too, Mishka immediately liked her (and she can be picky!). Would recommend Furry Tails to anyone who wants their dog treated the best.

I was recommended Furry Tails Toronto by a neighbour who used them for daily dog walks and my partner and I signed up for a meet and greet. Georgina is lovely, extremely communicative and it is clear that she loves what she does! Our puppy was a bit standoffish at first but Georgina won him and his trust over so quickly. We generally book him once or twice a week on her 1 hr hikes which is extremely worth it. Our puppy gets to interact with other dogs, new scenarios and it’s a really enriching experience for him overall. I love the report cards that we receive afterwards as it gives us insight into what an amazing day he’s had with the pack!! We’ve had great experiences with every dog walker from FTT and couldn’t recommend them more!
Georgina and her team are absolutely amazing. Georgina has been so flexible and accommodating to our dogs needs.

Georgina visited our cat Mochi during the holidays and we couldn't have been happier! Each visit came with detailed information about how Mochi was doing, what was done (food he was fed, litter box cleaning, etc) and five pictures from the visit. Georgina's communication was great and we were very thankful that she was willing to visit twice a day while we were away for Christmas. Highly recommend!
Very highly recommended! Georgina put our minds at ease while we were away. Great communication throughout. All was well when we returned home. We will definitely be using her services again.

Georgina and Furry Tales are the best! I was away for a week and Georgina picked up my fur baby every day for a run and swim. Jayne had so much fun every day and even got to ride shotgun! I received super cute pictures and a GPS tracker after every walk, including updates on all of Jayne’s new friends to show off at my workshop ;) My parents loved that he came home super happy and ready to pass out for his afternoon nap. Thank you so much Furry Tales, we’re already in touch for future adventures! :) :)

The professionalism and service I received from Furry Tales was fantastic!  Georgina did a great job looking after my golden retriever and what I really appreciate is how accommodating Georgina was on such short notice!  Highly recommend!!

We recommend furry tails to everyone we know! Georgina is fantastic - always dependable and a great communicator! we love the pictures and notes she sends after walks or while we’re away.  Our very large dog can be shy but Georgina won him over quickly and now he absolutely adores her!
Georgina does a great job with our dog Otis. He gets to go to cherry beach on group trips and runs through Taylor Creek. Flexible scheduling and great communication. Highly recommend.

Georgina has been awesome with our dog, Clover. We've been using her services for the past year. She started with puppy visits and now she goes every week with the pack to Cherry beach. She sends photos and a video of their adventure afterwards - the dogs have a blast.
Georgina and Christa have been so great with our dogs. They are reliable, trustworthy and professional. We have been very happy with Furry Tails’ service.
Thank you for your 5-star review, Pablo!

Juneau ABSOLUTELY LOVES her group walks and daycares with Furrytails! Best part of her day and she comes back nice and tired. Georgina is very patient and caring, she worked with Juneau on gaining her trust as she is shy with strangers. Would very highly recommend for your pup!
